changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_remotecontrol_settings ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, customerId INT NOT NULL, stunUrl VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302', turnUrl VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', turnUsername VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', turnPassword VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', CONSTRAINT plugin_rc_settings_pk PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT plugin_rc_settings_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (customerId) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT plugin_rc_settings_customer_uniq UNIQUE (customerId) ) ENGINE=InnoDB;

changeSet.author: custom
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_remotecontrol_sessions ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, customerId INT NOT NULL, deviceId INT NOT NULL, deviceNumber VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, adminUserId INT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, startTs BIGINT NOT NULL, endTs BIGINT, CONSTRAINT plugin_rc_sessions_pk PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT plugin_rc_sessions_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (customerId) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB; CREATE INDEX plugin_rc_sessions_device_idx ON plugin_remotecontrol_sessions (deviceNumber, status);
